description: Document ITERATE-TO-BEST honestly across the docs, prompt, and Tier-0. Add/extend the ARCHITECTURE Iterate-to-Best section (fused acceptance = green + reviewer gate, the single shared decision function + its three callers, best-so-far + bounded stop-and-ask semantics, the honest 'best = meets configured thresholds or closest bounded attempt, NOT provably optimal' framing; reaffirm the labeled deferred phases). Update USAGE (tuning the 'best' thresholds, what convergence/stop looks like, VS 2022 notes), PROOF (executed decision/cap/best-so-far vs worked-example fixes), README, the apia-iterate prompt, and a concise Tier-0 update - keeping copilot-instructions.md under its ~6500-byte ceiling.
steps: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: add a new section (e.g. 3b-bis / extend 3b 'Layer 2 - iterative self-correction loop' and reference 3d's composable gate) describing ITERATE-TO-BEST: fused acceptance = tests/build green AND Layer-1 green AND reviewer gate (scan.apply_thresholds vs review.thresholds) passes; the SINGLE shared decision function evaluate_quality_gated and its three callers (verify.py --iterate, scaffold.decide_generation, orchestrate.decide_task); scanner findings folded into the existing structured failure report; best-so-far tracking + bounded convergence/stop/ask under max_iterations; the config knobs (review.thresholds + the iterate-to-best keys under existing structures). State the honest framing explicitly: 'best' = meets the user-configured deterministic thresholds (green + reviewer gate) OR the closest bounded attempt with an honest residual report, NOT a guarantee of globally optimal/provably perfect code; the ceiling is the underlying Copilot model, test quality, and what scanners detect. Reaffirm the deferred phases (C#/Groovy adapters, MCP data sources, auto-push/MR/CI/packaging/signing, VS Code marketplace extension, cross-team/org sharing + plugins).

USAGE.md: in the self-correction loop + Reviewer + Tuning sections, document how to tune the 'best' thresholds (review.thresholds and the iterate-to-best knobs), what convergence vs stop-and-ask looks like (green+gate pass => converged; cap => stop with best-so-far + a specific ask), the headless command(s) to drive the fused iterate cycle with findings, and the VS 2022 note (the fused loop is expressible by a single agent via the prompt/Tier-0; VS 2022 honors only Tier-0 + Tier-1 prompts).

docs/PROOF.md: extend the Layer-1/Layer-2 proof section with the iterate-to-best proof - the EXECUTED decision/cap/best-so-far/failure-report machinery (reproducible commands + observed results) vs the worked-example per-iteration fixes, in the existing 'executed in-sandbox vs fixture/worked-example' honest style. State clearly which parts were genuinely executed (Python at minimum; C++ if run) and which are worked-example fixes.
README.md: add a concise iterate-to-best bullet/paragraph consistent with the existing phase summaries and honest framing.

.github/prompts/apia-iterate.prompt.md: update so iteration now targets GREEN + thresholds (not merely green): the acceptance criterion is tests/build green AND the reviewer gate passes; on a failing gate feed the structured scanner findings back; on non-convergence at the cap, STOP with the best-so-far iteration + a specific residual ask. Keep the single-agent / VS 2022 framing and the no-external-LLM clause.

.github/copilot-instructions.md (Tier-0): add a concise note that the iterate loop targets green + configured thresholds and stops with best-so-far + a specific ask on non-convergence. Keep it SHORT - the file is currently 6053 bytes; stay under ~6500 bytes (trim elsewhere if needed to make room).
Verify the Tier-0 byte count stays under the ceiling and the apia-iterate prompt still has valid front-matter.
acceptance_criteria: ARCHITECTURE.md has an Iterate-to-Best section covering fused acceptance, the single shared function + three callers, findings-in-failure-report, best-so-far + bounded stop-and-ask, config knobs, and the explicit honest-framing + reaffirmed deferred phases.
USAGE.md documents tuning the 'best' thresholds, convergence vs stop-and-ask, the headless commands, and the VS 2022 note.
PROOF.md honestly separates the executed decision/cap/best-so-far machinery from the worked-example per-iteration fixes.
README.md and the apia-iterate prompt reflect green + thresholds and best-so-far stop-and-ask.
.github/copilot-instructions.md remains under ~6500 bytes and reflects the fused loop.
verification: .venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests/ -q (timeout >= 600000 ms) still green (docs changes do not break tests)
findings: Docs-only + prompt + Tier-0 (NO production/test behavior change). Edits: (1) docs/ARCHITECTURE.md - added an 'Iterate-to-Best (Phase 5)' subsection inside 3b (fused acceptance = tests/build green AND Layer-1 green AND reviewer gate; the ONE shared evalloop.evaluate_quality_gated + its three callers verify.py --iterate/--findings, scaffold.decide_generation (honest-partial never green), orchestrate.decide_task (verdict verbatim); scanner_findings + reviewer_gate folded into the EXISTING failure report; score_iteration/best_so_far/_residual_summary groups by SEVERITY e.g. high=1; HARD max_iterations stop carrying BEST not last; config = review.thresholds + the only new knob eval_data.iterate_to_best.best_so_far_tie_break; explicit honest framing). Updated 3d/3e/3f deferred notes + section 7 roadmap: iterate-to-best fusion now DELIVERED (Phase 5); C#/Groovy, MCP, auto-push/PR/CI, marketplace, cross-team sharing remain DEFERRED. (2) README.md - concise Iterate-to-Best bullet with honest framing. (3) USAGE.md - added 'Iterate-to-Best: green AND the reviewer gate' (the --findings headless command, convergence vs stop-and-ask, VS 2022 single-agent note) + 'Tuning the best quality bar' (review.thresholds + best_so_far_tie_break yaml). Pre-existing em dashes elsewhere in USAGE.md left untouched (out of scope); my added text uses ' - '. (4) docs/PROOF.md - 'Iterate-to-Best: green AND the reviewer gate (Phase 5)' subsection in the executed-vs-worked-example style (DECISION/threshold/cap/best-so-far/failure-report EXECUTED+asserted; per-iteration code FIX is worked-example scripted findings change; Python real pytest + C++ real CMake/GoogleTest/CTest guarded by shutil.which; reproducible scan->iterate --findings commands; observed results from FEAT-003 tests). (5) .github/prompts/apia-iterate.prompt.md - retargeted to iterate-to-best (acceptance = green AND reviewer gate; feed exact scanner findings back; stop with best-so-far + specific residual ask); front-matter still valid YAML (keys agent/description/tools), no em dash. (6) .github/copilot-instructions.md Tier-0 - step 3 now says target green + review.thresholds and stop with best-so-far + specific ask; file now 6362 bytes (< 6500 ceiling). VERIFIED: Tier-0 6362 bytes < 6500; prompt front-matter parses via yaml.safe_load; full suite 293 passed in ~246s. REVIEW-FIX (2026-10-13 review-v1, NEEDS_CHANGES): (A) BLOCKING fix for the broken reproduction command - scan.py now has a --json-only flag (implies --json) that emits ONLY the JSON report (no human summary / no doctor table), so `scan.py ... --json-only > scan.json` is valid JSON that feeds straight into `verify.py --iterate --findings`. Existing --json dual human+JSON behavior is UNCHANGED (backward compatible). USAGE.md (step 1) and docs/PROOF.md both updated to use --json-only. Added test_scan.py::test_json_only_emits_parseable_json (asserts no 'APIA scan ::' header + json.loads succeeds) and test_json_still_emits_human_plus_json (asserts --json keeps dual output). (B) NON-BLOCKING parity fix - scaffold.decide_generation's stop branch now threads fused['best_so_far'] (added additively) and names evalloop._residual_summary(best_so_far) in the ask, reaching parity with the standalone iterate stop; existing return keys preserved. Extended test_decide_generation_iterates_then_stops_at_cap to assert best_so_far present, and added test_decide_generation_stop_carries_best_so_far_with_residual (seeded HIGH finding, green verify -> stop carries best_so_far with 'high=1' in the ask). VERIFIED: full suite 296 passed in ~255s (293 baseline + 3 new); the exact documented end-to-end command now runs cleanly (scan rc=1/verify rc=1 reflect the gate decision, not a parse error).
